title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-119-26二模

items.zh: 春节的意义体现在和谁一起过年,而非在哪里过年。
items.en: The meaning behind the Spring Festival lies in who you are with rather than where you are.

items.zh: 借助光影,学生们开启了一段科学与艺术交融的探索之旅。
items.en: Aided by light and shadow, students set off on a journey where science and art join together.

items.zh: 来到这座南方小城三十年,所见飘雪,成规模者,数场而已。
items.en: Notable snowfalls have been few and far between since I moved to this small southern city thirty years ago.

items.zh: 当技术回归服务于人的目的,城市的每一次智能化升级都能听见普通人的声音。
items.en: When technology reverts to serving people, each upgrade in smart cities takes the voice of ordinary people into account.
